description: analogWrite on the six Uno PWM pins and the switch from PWM back to digital.
basis: wiring_analog.c of arduino:avr@1.8.8: analogWrite(0) and analogWrite(255) are digitalWrite(LOW/HIGH), other values set OCRnx; wiring.c runs timers 0 to 2 in 8-bit PWM modes, so the duty cycle equals the value; digitalWrite on a PWM pin clears its COM bits (turnOffPWM)
